label: September 21–27, 2026
intro: This weekend — get Thor's hands in clay at a legendary Bangkok pottery studio, then glide into the week on ice!
weekday_note: Thursday and Friday are great days to book the ceramic workshop (available Sep 24–Oct 2 with no weekend crowds).

activities.title: Ceramic Workshop for Kids — Charm-Learn Studio
activities.time: Available sessions from 3:00 PM (check ClassBento for slots)
activities.location: Charm-Learn Studio, 95 Phraeng Sanphasat Rd, Phra Nakhon — Bangkok Old Town
activities.price: ฿7,000 per person (min 2 guests = ฿14,000 for you + Thor), 1.5 hrs
activities.why: Pinch pots, slab building, coils — Thor gets to make real pottery from scratch and decorate it himself. Thor is exactly old enough (min age 5). Award-winning studio by Silpakorn graduates.
activities.tip: Book directly on classbento.co.th — look for available slots between Sep 24–Oct 2. The studio is in Bangkok's old town: combine with a tuk-tuk ride through the neighbourhood.

activities.title: Ice Skating at The Rink — CentralWorld
activities.location: The Rink, Floor 2 Zone Forum, CentralWorld (BTS Chit Lom / Siam)
activities.price: ~350–450 THB/session (1.5 hrs, skate rental included). Call 081-875-1212 for current rates.
activities.why: Bangkok's best ice rink — practice penguins for balance, staff always helping the little ones. Thor will be gliding in 20 minutes.
activities.tip: Go at 10am when it opens — smooth ice, no queues. Pair with lunch at the Central World food court above.

activities.title: Neilson Hays Library Storytime
activities.location: Neilson Hays Library, Surawong Road, Bang Rak
activities.why: Themed stories + craft activity in a gorgeous 100-year-old reading room. Great calm Saturday morning kickoff before wilder activities.
activities.tip: Arrive 10 min early to grab seats. After, wander the beautiful colonial garden — perfect for photos.

activities.title: Rollerblading at Roller Dome — Emporium
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Shopping Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (BTS Phrom Phong)
activities.why: Thor loves rollerblading — this is Southeast Asia's largest rink with trained coaches and a smooth oval track perfect for beginners.
activities.tip: Weekends are lively and fun but can get busy after 2pm. Go at opening for a calmer experience. Easy BTS access.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum — Chatuchak
activities.location: Children's Discovery Museum, 810 Kamphaeng Phet 4 Rd, Chatuchak (BTS Mo Chit / MRT Chatuchak Park)
activities.price: FREE (bring passport/ID to register at entrance)
activities.why: Construction zone, science experiments, role-play areas, dinosaur dig sandbox, water play, and a cooking class corner — Thor can spend a full morning building and discovering.
activities.tip: Bring a change of clothes — the water play area is a hit. Free parking if you drive. Near Chatuchak market if you want to browse after.
